label: The stage-one node, by the distributive powers at a concrete foundational being (inference)
rule: The foundational being is under no power over its esse, so it is not an actual contingent concretum; excluded middle
meaning: A concrete foundational being f at w is under no being's POWER_OVER_ESSE_1. Were it absent at a world accessible from w, it would be a concrete being contingent at w, and the holder would have POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over it. So, with excluded middle, f exists at every world accessible from w; being concrete and actual, it witnesses the stage-one node.
